definitions.explanation: A formal agreement between parties, especially between organizations or countries.

examples.japanese: ⟦{両国|りょうこく}→両国：10010_ryoukoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{貿易|ぼうえき}→貿易：01727_boueki⟧{協定|きょうてい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{結|むす}んだ→結ぶ：02308_musubu⟧。
examples.english: The two countries signed a trade agreement.

examples.japanese: ⟦{労使|ろうし}→労使：27897_roushi⟧{協定|きょうてい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{締結|ていけつ}する→締結：13870_teiketsu⟧。
{協定|きょうてい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{違反|いはん}する→違反：01824_ihan⟧。

notes:
{協定|きょうてい} refers to a formal agreement between organizations, governments, or parties. It implies mutual negotiation and consensus, composed of {協|きょう} (cooperate) + {定|てい} (fix/determine).

TYPES:
- ⟦{貿易|ぼうえき}→貿易：01727_boueki⟧{協定|きょうてい}: trade agreement
- ⟦{労使|ろうし}→労使：27897_roushi⟧{協定|きょうてい}: labor-management agreement
- ⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧{協定|きょうてい}: international agreement
- ⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧⟦{貿易|ぼうえき}→貿易：01727_boueki⟧{協定|きょうてい}: free trade agreement (FTA)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {協定|きょうてい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{結|むす}ぶ→結ぶ：02308_musubu⟧: to conclude an agreement
- {協定|きょうてい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{締結|ていけつ}する→締結：13870_teiketsu⟧: to sign/conclude an agreement (formal)
- {協定|きょうてい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{違反|いはん}する→違反：01824_ihan⟧: to violate an agreement

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{条約|じょうやく}→条約：04912_jouyaku⟧: treaty (formal, between nations, often with legal force)
- ⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧: contract (business or personal, legally binding)
- ⟦{合意|ごうい}→合意：05093_goui⟧: mutual agreement, consensus (less formal than {協定|きょうてい})
- ⟦{同盟|どうめい}→同盟：05321_doumei⟧: alliance (broader political/military relationship)
